column1: TC_ID | Title | Preconditions | Steps | Expected Result

AUD-001 | Voice list shows loading state | User opens Audiobooks screen; personas/sessions not yet fetched | 1. Navigate to Audiobooks screen 2. Observe voice picker area immediately after load starts | Voice picker shows a small spinner and text "Loading your voices…" until personas/sessions requests resolve

AUD-002 | Voice list load failure shows retry | Persona service call (VoicesService.list) throws/fails | 1. Open Audiobooks screen with persona API failing 2. Observe voice picker area | Picker shows "Could not load your voices: $e" text with a "Retry" button; tapping Retry re-invokes _loadSessions()

AUD-003 | Voice picker empty state | Account has zero registered personas and zero capture sessions | 1. Open Audiobooks screen 2. Open voice dropdown | Dropdown hint reads "No voices yet — record one first" instead of "Select a voice…"; Generate remains reachable but no voice can be selected

AUD-004 | Persona auto-preselected over session | Account has at least one persona with canNarrate=true and at least one unregistered session | 1. Open Audiobooks screen 2. Observe voice picker's initial value | The newest persona (personas.first) is preselected as 'persona:<id>', not any session, because persona selection short-circuits before sessions are considered

AUD-005 | Newest unregistered session preselected when no personas exist | Account has zero narratable personas but at least one capture session not yet registered as a persona | 1. Open Audiobooks screen with only unregistered sessions available | The newest unregistered session (unregistered.first) is preselected as 'session:<id>'

AUD-006 | Selecting a session voice triggers clone-ready probe | At least one unregistered session exists in the picker | 1. Open voice dropdown 2. Select a session-type entry (label contains "unregistered recording") | _checkCloneReady(sessionId) fires; _selectedCloneReady is set to null (checking) then updated to the probe's result

AUD-007 | Clone-not-ready session blocks generation | A selected session's isCloneReady probe returns false | 1. Select a session voice whose clone is not ready 2. Observe form below the voice picker 3. Attempt to tap "Generate audiobook" | Warning text "This recording has no usable voice reference yet, so it can't narrate. Pick another, or record again." is shown, and the Generate button's onPressed is null (disabled) because _selectedCloneReady == false

AUD-008 | Clone-ready probe failure fails open | isCloneReady() throws for the selected session | 1. Select a session voice while the readiness endpoint is failing | _selectedCloneReady is set to true (fail-open) rather than blocking the user, per the "let the API be the judge" comment; Generate button stays enabled

AUD-009 | Personas that cannot narrate are excluded from picker | Account has a persona with canNarrate=false among its voices | 1. Open Audiobooks screen 2. Open voice dropdown | Only personas where v.canNarrate is true appear in the persona list; the non-narratable persona is absent

AUD-010 | Sessions already registered as a persona are hidden | A capture session's id matches an existing persona.sessionId | 1. Open Audiobooks screen with a session that has a registered persona 2. Open voice dropdown | That session does NOT appear separately in the session list (registered sessions are filtered out via the `registered` set), avoiding a duplicate voice entry

AUD-011 | Generate blocked when voice/title/text missing | No text source (widget.sourceBookId/sourcePdfId both null) | 1. Leave Title and Book text empty, or leave voice unselected 2. Tap "Generate audiobook" | Form shows error "A voice, a title and some text are all required." and no generation.start() call is made

AUD-012 | Generate blocked when text exceeds 20,000-char cap | No server source (typed-text flow); text field has >20,000 characters | 1. Paste/type text over 20,000 characters into Book text 2. Fill Title and select a Voice 3. Tap "Generate audiobook" | Form error reads "Text is {count} characters — the limit is 20,000." (values formatted with thousands separators, e.g. "Text is 20,150 characters — the limit is 20,000."); AudiobooksService.maxTextChars = 20000 is the cap and no request is sent

AUD-013 | Character counter highlights when over cap | Book text field is being edited | 1. Type text approaching, then exceeding, 20,000 characters 2. Observe the "X / 20,000" counter under the text field | Counter text turns accent-colored and bold (FontWeight.w700) once _charCount > 20000; otherwise it stays ink3/regular weight

AUD-014 | Form fields disabled while a narration is running | A generation task is currently active (isBusy == true) | 1. Start a narration 2. While it is still queued/running, revisit the Audiobooks screen form | Voice dropdown onChanged is null, Title/Style/Book-text TextFields have enabled:false, auto-emotion checkbox onChanged is null, and Generate button shows loading:true with onPressed null

AUD-015 | Server-sourced generation via book_id skips text entry | Screen opened with sourceBookId set (catalogue title) | 1. Open Audiobooks screen with a non-null sourceBookId 2. Observe the "Source" section | Book-text TextField is replaced by a "Source" card showing sourceSummary text and the note "The full text is narrated from the store copy — no length limit, and nothing to paste in."; the 20,000-char cap check is skipped (_hasServerSource true) even if local text is empty

AUD-016 | Server-sourced generation via pdf_id | Screen opened with sourcePdfId set (a store PDF, e.g. the 34-page PDF under "Your Books · PDF") | 1. Open Audiobooks screen with sourcePdfId populated 2. Fill Title and select a Voice 3. Tap "Generate audiobook" | generation.start() is called with pdfId set and text/bookId following the same "exactly one source" rule; server reads the PDF's text itself rather than the app sending it, confirming audiobooks can be generated directly from a stored PDF using the selected voice

AUD-017 | Default source summary when none supplied | sourceBookId or sourcePdfId is set but sourceSummary is null | 1. Open Audiobooks screen with a server source and no sourceSummary | Source card falls back to displaying "A title from the store" as the heading text

AUD-018 | "Loaded from <file>" hint shown for imported text | Screen opened with sourceFilename set and initialText populated (e.g. from the PDF page picker's "Use selection in Audiobooks") | 1. Open Audiobooks screen via the PDF picker with a filename and extracted text | Text-source form shows "Loaded from <sourceFilename> — review the extracted text before generating." above the editable text box, and the text box is pre-filled with initialText

AUD-019 | Narration style left blank is sent as null | Style field ("Narration style (optional)") left empty | 1. Fill Voice, Title, Text 2. Leave Narration style blank 3. Tap Generate | AudiobooksService.create() sends voice_style: null (not an empty string) per the trim/blank check, matching web-client behavior

AUD-020 | Auto-emotion checkbox default and toggle | Audiobooks screen freshly opened | 1. Observe the "Auto emotion direction: narrate each passage on the emotion-matched clip" row 2. Tap the row/checkbox to toggle it | Checkbox is checked (_autoEmotion = true) by default; tapping toggles the state and the value is passed as auto_emotion on generate

AUD-021 | Successful submit shows "Narration started" dialog | Valid voice, title, and text/source supplied; MwGenerationScope is available; not currently busy | 1. Fill a valid form 2. Tap "Generate audiobook" | A non-dismissible-by-barrier AlertDialog appears titled "Narration started" with body text "\"{title}\" is being narrated. This usually takes 10–15 minutes." and "You don't have to wait here — carry on using the app and we'll notify you the moment it's ready. You can follow its progress at the bottom of the screen."; an "OK" button closes it

AUD-022 | Generate button disabled while another narration runs | isBusy is already true from a prior submission | 1. Start one narration 2. Attempt to fill and submit the form again before it finishes | "Generate audiobook" button is disabled (loading spinner shown), and helper text "A narration is already running. You can start another one when it finishes — we'll notify you." is displayed below it

AUD-023 | Generation unavailable when scope missing | MwGenerationScope.maybeOf(context) returns null (e.g. widget rendered outside the app shell) | 1. Attempt to submit a valid generate form in a context with no MwGenerationScope ancestor | Form error is set to "Generation is unavailable right now." and no task is created

AUD-024 | In-flight task appears above the audiobook list | A generation task has been started and is still active | 1. Start a narration 2. Scroll to "Your audiobooks" | The task appears as a queued-style row above existing books, showing task.title and task.statusLabel, with a small "queued"/"running" badge and a spinning progress indicator

AUD-025 | Task status label reflects generation stage | A GenerationTask progresses through its lifecycle | 1. Start a narration and observe its status text over time | Label reads "Starting…" (stage=starting), then "Queued — one narration runs at a time" (queued), then the latest SSE detail or "Narrating…" (running), then the row disappears from "in-flight" once done (replaced by the finished book)

AUD-026 | Generation failure is surfaced with a reason | The create() call or job-follow logic errors out | 1. Trigger a generation that fails server-side or via a dropped/failed job | task.stage becomes failed and task.error holds a message such as "Generation failed: $e", "Narration failed.", or "Narration finished with status \"{status}\"."; statusLabel falls back to "Narration failed" if error is null; a local "audiobook failed" notification is shown via NotificationService

AUD-027 | Completed generation refreshes the book list automatically | AudiobooksScreen is open while a tracked task completes | 1. Start a narration and keep the Audiobooks screen open until it finishes | _onGenerationComplete() fires via the completion listener and calls _loadBooks(), so the finished book appears in "Your audiobooks" without a manual pull-to-refresh

AUD-028 | Empty audiobook library state | Account has zero audiobooks and zero in-flight tasks | 1. Open Audiobooks screen for an account with no books generated yet | "Your audiobooks" section shows "Nothing generated yet." instead of a list

AUD-029 | Audiobook list loading indicator | Books list is being fetched (_loadingBooks true) | 1. Open or refresh the Audiobooks screen | A centered MwLoader (small) is shown in place of the list while loading

AUD-030 | Audiobook list load failure message | AudiobooksService.list() throws for all pipeline versions | 1. Open Audiobooks screen while the audiobooks API is failing | "Could not load your audiobooks: $e" is displayed in place of the list

AUD-031 | Pull-to-refresh reloads voices and books together | Audiobooks screen is open | 1. Pull down on the list to trigger RefreshIndicator | Both _loadSessions() and _loadBooks() are re-invoked concurrently (Future.wait)

AUD-032 | Manual refresh icon reloads the book list | Audiobooks screen is open, not currently loading | 1. Tap the refresh IconButton next to "Your audiobooks" | _loadBooks() runs again; the icon's onPressed is null (disabled) while _loadingBooks is true

AUD-033 | Non-playable audiobook row is not tappable | An audiobook exists whose manifest is null or has zero chapters (e.g. still processing or errored) | 1. View "Your audiobooks" list 2. Tap a row whose status/manifest indicates it isn't playable | Row's onTap is null (book.isPlayable false), title is shown in ink2 (not accent) color, and an hourglass_empty icon is shown instead of play_arrow; tapping does nothing

AUD-034 | Playable audiobook row opens the player | An audiobook has manifest.chapters non-empty | 1. Tap a playable audiobook row | Navigates via MaterialPageRoute to AudiobookPlayerScreen, passing apiClient, the AudiobooksService instance, and the selected Audiobook

AUD-035 | Status badge color coding | Audiobooks with statuses done/error/cancelled/queued/running exist | 1. View the audiobook list and in-flight tasks with varying statuses | Badge for "done" renders in green (#3D5A2A); "error" and "cancelled" render in the accent (red/warning) color; any other status (queued/running/unknown) renders in ink3 (grey); badge text is the uppercase status

AUD-036 | Player screen shows loading spinner while preparing | AudiobookPlayerScreen just pushed for a book | 1. Open a playable audiobook | A centered large MwLoader is shown while _prepare() re-fetches the book (if not yet playable) and builds audio sources

AUD-037 | Player screen error state for a book with no chapters | Book's manifest is null or has an empty chapters list even after refetch | 1. Open an audiobook whose chapters end up empty | Error text "This audiobook has no chapters yet (status: {status})." is shown centered with a "Retry" button that re-runs _prepare()

AUD-038 | Player re-fetches book detail when not yet playable | The Audiobook object passed in is not yet playable (e.g. list was stale) | 1. Open a book that just finished generating while the cached list was stale | AudiobookPlayerScreen calls audiobooksService.getById(book.id, version: book.apiVersion) to refresh the manifest before building audio sources

AUD-039 | Generic load failure on the player screen | ApiClient/AudioPlayer setAudioSources throws (e.g. network error) | 1. Open a book while media/API access fails | Error text "Could not load this audiobook: $e" is shown with a Retry button that calls _prepare() again

AUD-040 | Chapter list tap seeks to chosen chapter | Book has 2+ chapters loaded in AudiobookPlayerScreen | 1. Open the chapter list 2. Tap a chapter other than the current one | _player.seek(Duration.zero, index: index) is called, jumping playback to the start of that chapter

AUD-041 | Current chapter is visually highlighted | Playback is on a specific chapter index | 1. Play/seek into a chapter 2. Observe the chapter list | The current chapter's index number and title render in accent color (title bold), and a graphic_eq icon appears as trailing; other rows show ink/ink3 and no trailing icon

AUD-042 | Chapter title falls back to "Chapter N" when empty | A chapter's title field from the manifest is an empty string | 1. Load a book whose manifest chapter has title: "" | List row displays "Chapter {index+1}" instead of a blank title

AUD-043 | Play/pause toggle and completed-state replay | AudiobookPlayerScreen transport is visible | 1. Tap the center play button while paused 2. Tap again to pause while playing 3. Let/force playback to processingState.completed, then tap play again | Paused→playing calls _player.play(); playing→paused calls _player.pause(); if processingState is completed, tapping seeks to (Duration.zero, index:0) then plays again instead of doing nothing

AUD-044 | Skip previous/next respect chapter boundaries | Currently on the first or last chapter | 1. On the first chapter, check the skip_previous button 2. On the last chapter, check skip_next | Skip-previous button's onPressed is null when _player.hasPrevious is false; skip-next's onPressed is null when hasNext is false — both are visually disabled at the boundaries

AUD-045 | Seek slider updates playback position | A chapter with known duration is loaded | 1. Drag the progress Slider in AudiobookPlayerScreen or PlayerScreen to a new position | _player.seek(Duration(milliseconds: v.round())) is invoked; slider is disabled (onChanged null) when duration/max <= 0

AUD-046 | Buffering indicator replaces play icon | processingState is loading or buffering | 1. Trigger a chapter load/seek that causes buffering | The center play/pause button area shows a CircularProgressIndicator instead of the play/pause icon, on both AudiobookPlayerScreen and PlayerScreen

AUD-047 | NowPlaying resumes from last saved server position | PlaybackService.getProgress(book.id) returns a prior, unfinished position within a valid chapter index | 1. Reopen a previously partially-listened book via NowPlayingController.open() | player.setAudioSources() is called with initialIndex/initialPosition taken from the saved PlaybackProgress rather than starting at chapter 0 / position 0

AUD-048 | Resume falls back to start when no saved progress or lookup fails | getProgress() throws, or progress.finished is true, or chapterIndex is out of range | 1. Open a book with no prior playback record (or one already marked finished) | Playback starts at startIndex=0, startAt=Duration.zero (the exception is swallowed silently)

AUD-049 | Reopening the same book is a no-op | NowPlayingController.book already equals the book being opened | 1. While a book is already loaded/playing, call open() again with the same book | Method returns immediately without cancelling timers/subscriptions or reloading audio sources, so playback is not interrupted or restarted

AUD-050 | Playback progress auto-saved every ~10 seconds | A book is playing in NowPlayingController | 1. Start playback and let it run for 20+ seconds | saveProgress() is called roughly every 10 seconds via the periodic Timer, sending current chapterIndex and positionSec

AUD-051 | Progress saved immediately on pause | Playback is active then paused | 1. Play a chapter 2. Tap pause | The playerStateStream listener detects !state.playing and calls _saveProgress() immediately, independent of the 10s timer

AUD-052 | Progress marked finished on completion | Playback reaches the end of the last chapter (processingState == completed) | 1. Let a short chapter/book play to completion | _saveProgress(finished: true) is called, which PUTs finished: true to /api/playback/{id}

AUD-053 | Skip back 10s clamps to zero | Position is less than 10 seconds into playback | 1. At position ~5s, tap the skipBack10 control | Target position (position - 10s) is negative, so player.seek(Duration.zero) is used instead of a negative seek

AUD-054 | Skip forward 10s clamps to chapter/track duration | Position is within 10 seconds of the end | 1. Near the end of a chapter, tap the forward_10 (skipForward10) control | Target position is capped at player.duration rather than seeking past the end

AUD-055 | Playback speed cycles through fixed steps | PlayerScreen or mini-player speed control is visible | 1. Tap the speed pill / "Playback speed" overflow item repeatedly | Speed cycles in order 0.8x -> 1.0x -> 1.25x -> 1.5x -> 2.0x -> back to 0.8x, calling player.setSpeed(speed) each time; label uses one decimal normally, two only when needed (e.g. "1.25x" not "1.30x")

AUD-056 | Text Sync toggle switches player body | PlayerScreen is open on a book | 1. Tap "Turn Text Sync on" in the overflow menu, or tap the subject icon in the secondary row | Body switches from _CoverBody to _TextSyncBody, showing a compact cover, the "Read by" pill, and an "Text Sync On" status pill; toggling again ("Turn Text Sync off") reverts to the cover view

AUD-057 | Text Sync shows message when no cues exist for a chapter | ChapterCues for the current chapter is empty or fetch returns no cues | 1. Enable Text Sync on a chapter without cue data | Centered text "No text available to sync for this chapter." is shown instead of a transcript

AUD-058 | Text Sync auto-scroll pauses after manual drag | Text Sync is on and cues are actively advancing | 1. While transcript is auto-scrolling, manually drag/scroll the list | Auto-scroll is suppressed for 3 seconds from the drag (_autoScrollPausedUntil), after which it resumes following the active cue

AUD-059 | Active cue highlighting and read/unread styling | Text Sync transcript is showing cues | 1. Observe the transcript as playback advances through sentences | The cue matching the current position is bold ink with accent-tinted background; cues before it render in ink3 (read/faded); cues after it render in ink2 (upcoming)

AUD-060 | Download for offline is a disabled/placeholder feature | PlayerScreen overflow menu or secondary row is open | 1. Open the overflow menu 2. Tap "Download for offline" 3. Separately tap the download icon in the secondary row | Overflow item shows subtitle "A Premium feature — not switched on yet" and tapping only closes the sheet with no action; secondary-row download icon is muted-colored and tapping shows snackbar "Offline downloads is coming in a future update." — confirms no functional offline/download flow exists yet

AUD-061 | Bookmarks and Sleep timer are placeholder features | PlayerScreen secondary row is visible | 1. Tap the bookmark_border icon 2. Tap the bedtime_outlined (sleep timer) icon | Each tap shows a SnackBar reading "Bookmarks is coming in a future update." / "Sleep timer is coming in a future update." respectively — no bookmark or timer is actually set

AUD-062 | Chapter indicator uses Roman numerals | PlayerScreen progress row is visible during playback | 1. Play chapter 3 (zero-indexed 2) 2. Observe the chapter pill between position/duration | Pill reads "Chapter III" (1-based index converted to Roman numerals via _toRoman)

AUD-063 | Player header dismiss does not stop playback | PlayerScreen is open and audio is playing | 1. Tap the down-chevron in the header | Navigator.maybePop() closes the screen only; because the screen is bound to the shared NowPlayingController/AudioPlayer rather than owning it, playback continues uninterrupted in the mini-player

AUD-064 | "Nothing loaded" placeholder when no book is active | NowPlayingController.book is null (nothing has been played this session) | 1. Open PlayerScreen without ever having opened an audiobook | Body shows centered text "Nothing loaded." instead of the cover/transport UI

AUD-065 | Generation job stream drop retries then gives up after repeated foreground failures | The SSE job stream and the polling fallback both repeatedly throw while the app stays in the foreground | 1. Start a narration 2. Simulate 5 consecutive foreground connection failures while following the job | Status text shows "Connection lost — reconnecting." during retries; after 5 foreground failures (maxForegroundFailures) the task fails with "Lost contact with the narration job. It may still be finishing on the server — pull down to refresh in a minute."

AUD-066 | Backgrounding the app during generation reconnects on resume | A narration job is being followed via SSE when the app is backgrounded | 1. Start a narration 2. Background the app mid-narration 3. Bring the app back to the foreground | didChangeAppLifecycleState detects AppLifecycleState.resumed, abandons the (possibly-dead) job stream via _abandonJobStream(), and _followJob reconnects/polls again without counting the interruption as a foreground failure

AUD-067 | Notification permission requested when generation starts | User taps Generate for the first time this session | 1. Submit a valid narration request | NotificationService.init() is invoked immediately (unawaited) while the "Narration started" dialog is still on screen, so the OS permission prompt appears while the user is actively engaged rather than 10–15 minutes later when the app may be backgrounded
